```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'bun'

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Verify skills
        run: bun run skills:verify

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun run test

      - name: Run lint
        run: bun run lint

      - name: Check Next.js version in AGENTS.md
        run: |
          if grep -q 'next@16.1.6' AGENTS.md; then
            echo "AGENTS.md contains outdated Next.js version 16.1.6. Please update to 16.2.1."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Notify code owner (if relevant files changed)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { data: files } = await github.rest.pulls.listFiles({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
            });
            const changedFiles = files.map(f => f.filename);
            const importantFiles = ['AGENTS.md', '.mcp.json', '.cursor/mcp.json'];
            const relevant = changedFiles.filter(f => importantFiles.includes(f));
            if (relevant.length > 0) {
              // Replace 'code-owner-username' with the actual code owner username or team
              await github.rest.pulls.requestReviewers({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
                reviewers: ['code-owner-username'],
              });
            }
```
